Well, I was born into the Jehovah's Witness cult, yes, it's a cult, so we were told not to see certain things, because most of them were demon related materials. For example, watching Chucky, Exorcist, and Guns And Roses, oh and Led Zeppelin. All Satan trying to seduce you.

Well 2 days later, I come home drunk, I was staying at my brother's after being kicked out by my father, so I slept in the living room, and his girlfriend had a dog that would usually just get on the sofa and sleep with me. So he's lying next to me, and in the middle of the night, I wake up suddenly because I literally felt a presence in the kitchen, and I'm not sure if I had my covers over my head, but they were at some point.

I couldn't see if the thing was real, but it was there, a presence, and Sparky jumped off the sofa whimpering and hid behind the sofa against the wall. It was quiet, and the presence came closer and closer, just looming over me, and I could see it, not really see it, just feel it bending down and staring at me, flashes of the little girl from the exorcist were flashing, and so was the blue demon from the film, which to be honest, made no sense because it had nothing to do with it. But the presence and the images were still there. I know I held my breath, and I imagine I must have turned pale white, because I was afraid, I mean really afraid. It was something I could not comprehend or explain.

But just as quickly as it came, it left, and for a long time, I didn't move, everything was quiet. Then Sparky moved once more, and got back to the sofa with me, which is when I finally uncovered myself. I guess I said something to Sparky, but he just looked like a normal dog, but I guess he had the look of, yeah, what the fuck happened. Just as confused I guess as I was. Over the years, I speculated on what it could be, was it really a demon? Was it an angel, yeah right, was it me maybe coming to see how I was doing from the future but being dissapointed? LOL, Was it an entity that was ready to communicate with me and I lost my chance? Was it my father? All these thoughts led me to a nervous breakdown, in which I still haven't really recovered. I'm an introvert that just stays at home, I can't really keep a job, not necessarily because of that moment, but just because of not being able to relate or take friendships to the next level. I never really accepted that I was part of anyone's life. There were many guesses of what I had experienced really, but to me, it felt, at the time, malevolent, but even that I'm not so sure, it never tried to hurt me, not really, but I was the one frightened so I never really got the chance to see it. I also from the time it started to the time it ended, kept the same posture and the covers over me, and the dog moved to the same spot as when it first started when it ended, and being a lucid dreamer now, I would have guessed that it was a very vivid lucid dream as well. I also thought it was my dad coming to visit me before he got a brain hemorrage and finally died in the hospital, in which I never had the chance to make ammends with him really.

The truth is, I still can't explain it, and I had a lot of romantic ideas that perhaps it was someone that knew me from a very long time, or a past life, or another dimension that came to impart knowledge to me and to communicate, but since I was so afraid of it, it decided I wasn't ready. I don't know, and I still think about it once in a while. But, it has yet to present itself again though, and I'm not sure I'd still be happy to see whatever it was.

I've seen light in the sky that happened to be on the landing path for nearby airports, and when I was a kid I saw a lot of weird shit in the night that fits the bill for sleep paralysis. There are only two things that remain unexplained in my mind.

Both happened on the same stretch of road. This is a two-lane road, a small town at one end and a disconnected clump of almost suburban homes at the other end. It's straight as an arrow on the map, and with just the slightest rises and dips so you can see quite a distance.

The first time, I was riding my bike home late at night, and the moon was illuminating everything just enough to see the shape of the road. Between the stars and clouds of the night sky, and the sparse woods surrounding the way home, I decided to ride with my lights off, just reflectors. I could just barely see the road itself, and if a car came along, I would have seen it coming from a long way - none did. I bent down into an aerodynamic position and jammed on the pedals, speeding along through the nocturnal wonderland.

And then there was a light, a tiny, dim little sliver, like a leaf. It was at handlebar height, it was sitting still, and it was close. Impossibly close - It was within my fucking handlebars before I knew what was happening. I vividly remember seeing it, and preparing myself for pain, because if it was a cell phone light or some other portable electronics, I had already hit the person who was holding it. And yet, there it was, and it passed within the span of my handlebars, and it was gone.

The second time, I was making the same trip in my friend's Suburban, and, like before, we were on a section of that road where a car's lights would have been visible for half a minute or so, even if they were hauling ass. The interior of the SUV lit up like a car was approaching from behind, but instead of the gradual approach of a passing car, the light went from barely noticeable to blindingly bright in only a few seconds. We were both startled, and we started looking around. Just when it would have passed us, it seemed to wink out completely. There were no taillights ahead of us, nor the illumination of a car's headlights on the road or trees ahead of us. The SUV didn't shake or anything from a passing vehicle, and if that glare was from somebody's headlights, they would have been going at least twice and perhaps three times the speed limit and running searchlights instead of headlights. Neither of us did get a direct look at it, but my friend was spooked because when I turned to him and said, "Was that...?" he urgently interrupted with, "I do not want to talk about it."

TL;DR: Unusual lights on roads in rural Kansas scare travelers.

When I was a kid we would drive from Winnemucca, NV to Reno, NV to shop at Costco and other large stores as we weren't very rich and we needed to stretch money as much as we could. Doing this once a month still made sense financially. The trip to Reno in the morning (we would spend all day between the trip and shopping) was interesting but par for the course in Nevada. Desolate, beautiful, striking... These are the kinds of words I would apply to it.

Driving back, inevitably after dark, was a different kind of experience. My mom and baby sister would almost always fall asleep, leaving me in the back seat of our Suburban, with my dad driving silently up front. Now, I was raised in the outdoors, but there is something creepy about night in Nevada. Something that feels somehow much larger and more powerful than anything human or manmade. You would sometimes be 40 miles from anything in any direction, driving in a frying pan flat valley between ancient mountain ranges. And there were sometimes weird lights behind the mountains (in my adult years I attribute this to a yet risen moon or mining, etc operations on the other side of the range).

But one time, there was something else too. We were driving as usual, especially late this time because even the incessant semi-truck traffic had died down to almost nothing. My dad was in the front, silent for what seemed like forever, everyone else asleep. I'm sitting in the almost pitch black back seat, my sister on the other side of the car behind my dad, myself behind my sleeping mom. I'm looking around, watching the outlines of deeper black of the mountain ranges pass by in the distance, letting my mind wander. At some point I look out my side window and see something strange, seemingly traveling alongside the car, or actually attached to it. As I stare at it and look away and back over the course of a minute or so it resolves into a pale emaciated face, hairless, mouth drawn open in a scream, almost like the painting of the same name but life sized and sitting in my window.

Being an inquisitive kid I didn't immediately think ghost but distorted reflection from inside the car, the way windows act like mirrors when it is dark enough outside (and it was most definitely dark enough outside). So, I start moving my head around, looking at the window from different angles, knowing that the reflection should move with my head, reflecting in different parts of the window. The face stays still. At this point I start scooting across the back bench seats towards my sleeping baby sister, never saying anything because of that child-like fear of interrupting and breaking the silence of the car, not wanting to not be believed. I start trying not to focus on the face, though I can't prevent myself from looking over fairly often. Finally after what seemed like forever but probably wasn't more than ten minutes at most, I looked over and the face was gone.

I curled up on the seat as best I could and tried to sleep like everyone else, and eventually succeeded, though this memory has stuck with me from the age of 4-5 until now (I'm 25).

My niece suffers from night terrors and also occasionally sleepwalks. My sister and I got thoroughly freaked out one night when she was about five; I was staying in her house and we were watching a movie and having a glass of wine when we suddenly heard my niece SCREAMING, 'don't you touch me, I don't know you, get away from me!'. We ran up the stairs and found her in bed sweating and thrashing around, so after a quick perimeter check we established that it was just a night terror, so we left her alone (which is what the sleep doctor had told us to do when she has them).

We were a bit freaked out so we went down stairs and into the kitchen to make some tea, then back into the sitting room to watch the rest of the movie. At this point my niece had gone quiet upstairs, so my sister went to mute the TV to make sure she was still sleeping. She reached out to grab the remote control off the arm of the couch, when the open door swung wildly and my niece jumped out from behind it, still asleep, and screamed 'you won't make it, I'm too fast and strong, you can't touch me!' then hissed like a snake. We both screamed so loudly that my niece woke up, started to get panicky because she didn't immediately recognise where she was, and started to cry.

In hindsight it was really funny, us both trying to calm her down and reassure her that she was okay, while at the same time not wanting to get too close in case the demon came out and dragged us down to hell.

But holy shit, little girls can be creepy enough without demonic screaming and appearing from nowhere with their eyes half closed and rolling.

EDIT should add, my niece was an identical twin but her twin sister died in infancy, and she has these very wide pale grey-blue eyes and very very pale skin. She's basically a character from a horror film even when she's happily eating chicken nuggets.

Alright, here goes:

About 4 years ago me and about three of my friends were bored and wanted to get a board game to occupy our time, but being a curious and morbid son of a bitch, I suggested that we get a Ouija board. They didn't know that it was, so after I explained it to them, they were interested and I ended up paying the most for it, so they didn't mind. Once we got back to the house with the Ouija board, I went online to read some general instructions and guidelines because (after the aforementioned story) I had at least some respect for the paranormal and/or just what exists out there that I don't know about.

A couple of the guidelines that I read online was that if the dial or pointer or whatever you call it starts counting down in numbers or in letters or making circles on the board, then it's a sign that whatever you're connecting to is attempting to break through that barrier. This may seem like an irrelevant detail, but it comes into play later.

We set up the Ouija board, turn off the lights, light some candles, and incense and decide that I'm going to be the Medium (the person who does the talking), because I'm a total idiot and that's what idiots do. Also, no one else knew what the fuck was going on. So we sit there asking questions, nothing happens for a long time, a few jokes get told, but I remind them that in order for it to work, we must be serious and committed because we're basically channeling something from another realm. Eventually, we all get really into it and start seeing some activity. I'm asking this "person" questions and the dial is moving slowly as if hesitating to respond. At first, we're only getting answers to yes or no questions, so we do that for an hour or so until it begins to respond to more complex questions.

The first person that we spoke to seemed to be very hostile in general. We'd asked them questions like "Where are you?" and "How did you die?" They rarely described where they were, but when asked if they were in the room with us, they always said no. When asking how this person died, he spelled out "HAMMER." (Also, just wanted to include that we asked each of them their names first. I just can't remember most of them.) Once he said "HAMMER," I asked if someone had killed him, and the dial immediately went over to YES. After a series of a few questions, we discovered that he was killed from behind with a hammer by someone in his family because of infidelity with that man's wife. Eventually though, he stopped answering questions, almost out of stubbornness because if we asked questions too eagerly, he'd hesitate, as if he didn't trust us. While asking a question, he spelled out "HELP." I asked what he wanted help with and he spelled "FIGHT" and then the dial began counting down in letters.

As our hands were moving across the letters one-by-one, I said to my friends "So guys, I read online that what's happening right now is him trying to escape the board, so we need to ask him another question." After asking another question, the countdown stopped and we decided that we were going to say goodbye and close that conversation to go smoke a cigarette.

We come back and start engaging with the board some more and end up getting in touch with someone named Rachel. She was very hesitant to answer any questions I had. She apparently had died in prison somewhere in the Midwest, and we spoke to her for HOURS. Not only was she hesitant at first, but when we'd laugh or make a joke or talk amongst ourselves about her, she would then start giving very short answers or answering very, very slowly as if she'd felt judged. I asked if she'd feel more comfortable speaking to Ashley (one of my friends) and the dial flew over to "YES." Once Ashley was asking questions, the answers were becoming more fluid and consistent. We were very focused on finding out why Rachel went to prison, but eventually she told Ashley that it was because she'd killed her husband because he was abusive and that she missed her children. We asked her if there was anything we could do for her and she wanted us to contact her children, but when we asked her last name, the word seemed like gibberish and produced no results online later.

After a few hours, we were just kind of treading water with Rachel and I was personally getting bored, so we close that conversation and take another break. Then we come back for one more after talking about what had been experienced so far and there was only one more person who spoke to us. I can't quite remember his name, it may have been Jared. Anyway, I was the medium for this one and I asked Jared his name and if he was in the room with us. He said "NO," when I asked where he was, he said "ER." I asked if he was alone and he said "NO" and whether he was sick and he replied "YES." The final question I had before our connection disconnected was "What are you sick with?" to which he spells out "C-A-N-C-E-R" and as his response lands on the "R," I felt as if my body was being softly electrocuted, such as when you stick your finger in an outlet as a kid. After that very strange physical sensation, Jared no longer answered any questions or reacted in any way.

We didn't use the Ouija board again after that. We were very engaged with it, but it was very very exhausting. Hopefully this story lived up to your expectations. =P
